full_judgment:
Mr. Mohammad Fazlul Karim, J. : The Plaintiff in a suit for declaration of title and recovery of possession moved this petition for leave to appeal against the impugned order discharging the rule against the judgment and decree dated 24.4.1998 passed in Title Appeal No. 213 of 1977 by the Subordinate Judge, 4th  Court, Mymensingh reversing those dated 30.7.1977 of the Munsif, Second Court, Jamalpur in Title Suit No.365 of 1968. 

 4. The trial Court decreed the suit and appeal therefrom was allowed. The petitioner moved the High Court Division unsuccessfully whereby the Rule was discharged by the impugned order. 

 5. Mr. Md. Fazlul Karim, the learned Counsel appearing for the petitioners submits that the lower appellate Court having found that the possession of the plaintiff on evidence in respect of .35 decimal of the suit land ought to have decreed the suit on the basis of the admitted possession inasmuch as the plaintiffs have auction purchased and got certificate of sale and the corresponding writ of delivery of possession in the suit land and that defendants have no valid claim on the suit land unless the auction sale held on 25.1.56 is set aside. 

 6. Admittedly the suit was for declaration of title and recovery of possession on the assertion that the plaintiff has been dispossessed from the suit land. The suit land measuring .70. decimal is part of the whole holding measuring 4.25 acres. The plaintiff alleged that the defendant dispossessed him from the suit land in the month of Chaitra before 11 years. None of the P.Ws. disclose the year of the possession on the basis of auction purchase although the plaintiff asserted the period to be Chaitra 1370 .B.S. corresponding to April 1966. The plaintiff previously filed Title Suit No.360 of 1968 wherein the finding was that the plaintiff did not get the possession of the suit land after alleged auction purchase and the Court of appeal below did not find possession of the plaintiff in the suit land after auction purchase. On the contrary found that defendants have been in possession in the suit land since 1350. B.S. Since plaintiff failed to prove his possession on the basis of auction purchase and that no definite date of dispossession could be proved in the suit land in spite of the fact that the defendant only claimed .35 decimals of the suit land, the plaintiff is not entitled to any decree of the suit for declaration of title and recovery of possession in respect of the alleged admitted portion of the suit land in possession of the plaintiff.
